QB M. Heintschel listed out-for-season
vs Michigan State: MSU QBs Alessio Milivojevic and Cam Fancher out, true freshman Kayd Coffman to start; UCLA also starting backup QB Ty Dieffenbach. UCLA leg kept but recheck line before kickoff.
Koundé (ankle) and Dani Olmo (adductor) out for El Clásico; Eric García and Christensen also out.
Storm Austen (80mph winds) puts Man United vs Bournemouth and Liverpool vs Brighton at risk of postponement; recheck before betting.
Lamar Jackson OUT (high left ankle sprain), third straight game; Tyler Huntley starts vs Bengals. LB Tavius Robinson (IR) and S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) also out.
Curry out (rest, back-to-back), Podziemski out (back); Draymond Green doubtful.
Malkin out (illness); Girard to IR; Chinakhov out. Silovs starts.
Levi on IR; Jarry starts vs Toronto; Ekholm out 3 games.
Yves Missi out (knee).
Jalen Duren OUT (hamstring) Sunday at 76ers; Ausar Thompson questionable (ankle).
Paolo Banchero out 4-6 weeks (high ankle sprain).
Knueppel, Coby White, Boswell, Grant Williams out vs Heat (2nd of back-to-back).

WR Puka Nacua questionable (calf), will test pregame; Davante Adams out (hamstring); CB Trent McDuffie Q, LB Nate Landman out. Recheck Rams -8.5 before kickoff.

Lamar Jackson confirmed OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts.
Mouhamed Gueye - Out: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
Henri Veesaar - Out: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Coby White - Out: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
Kon Knueppel - Out: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
Grant Williams - Out: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.
Kylan Boswell - Out: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.
Tobe Awaka - Out: Awaka (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
Patrick Williams - Out: Williams (adductor) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Knicks, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
Nic Claxton - Out: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
Naji Marshall - Out: Marshall (illness) won't play in Wednesday's game against Oklahoma City.
Tarik Biberovic - Out: Biberovic (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
Santi Aldama - Out: Aldama (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
Sergio de Larrea - Out: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
Dereck Lively II - Out: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.
Cameron Johnson - Out: Johnson (ankle) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.
Spencer Jones - Out: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.
Alpha Diallo - Out: Diallo is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans due to personal reasons.
Julian Strawther - Out: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
Isaiah Joe - Out: Joe (hip) is out for Wednesday's game against the Hornets.
Jalen Duren - Out: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Gui Santos - Out: Santos has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves due to left knee tendinitis.

Kristaps Porzingis - Out: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Moses Moody - Out: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jimmy Butler III - Out: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Marcus Smart - Out: Smart (forearm) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.
Alperen Sengun - Out: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.
Steven Adams - Out: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
T.J. McConnell - Out: Pacers head coach Rick Carlisle stated McConnell (hamstring) is "doing better" and "getting closer" to a return, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
Ben Sheppard - Out: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Tyrese Haliburton - Out: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Ivica Zubac - Out: Zubac (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.
Johnny Furphy - Out: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

Yanic Konan Niederhauser - Out: Niederhauser (foot) remains out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers. He also won't travel with the team for the upcoming two-game road trip in Minnesota and Golden State, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Max Strus - Out: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Brandon Ingram - Out: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Rui Hachimura - Out: Hachimura (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
Bradley Beal - Out: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Jordan Miller - Out: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Cameron Carr - Out: Carr (oblique) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Adou Thiero - Out: Thiero (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Ziaire Williams - Out: Williams (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Luka Doncic - Out: Doncic (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
Simone Fontecchio - Out: Fontecchio (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks.
Anthony Edwards - Out: Edwards will undergo arthroscopic right knee surgery and is expected to miss up to two months, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Donte DiVincenzo - Out: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Jordan Poole - Day-To-Day: Poole (ankle) won't return to Wednesday's game against the Nuggets. He finished with two points (1-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt), one rebound and one steal over seven minutes.
Yves Missi - Out: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Jose Alvarado - Out: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls.

Jalen Williams - Out: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.
Alex Caruso - Out: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Thomas Sorber - Out: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.
Chet Holmgren - Out: Holmgren (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.
Nikola Topic - Out: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.
Cason Wallace - Out: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Otega Oweh - Out: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.
Jonathan Isaac - Out: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Wednesday's game against the Raptors.
Jalen Suggs - Out: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Paolo Banchero - Out: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Noah Penda - Out: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Izaiyah Nelson - Out: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
Tacko Fall - Out: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Wednesday's game in Indiana.
Jabari Walker - Out: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pacers.
Dominick Barlow - Out: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Ariel Hukporti - Out: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Tobias Harris - Out: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Utah, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.
Jayden Quaintance - Out: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
Nate Bittle - Out: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.
Kawhi Leonard - Out: Leonard (knee) is expected to miss multiple weeks due to swelling in his left knee, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Darryn Peterson - Day-To-Day: Peterson exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Wednesday's game against the Spurs due to an apparent head injury, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
Lauri Markkanen - Out: Markkanen (wrist) is out for Wednesday's tilt against the Spurs.
Jaren Jackson Jr. - Out: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Trey Alexander - Out: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.
Jusuf Nurkic - Out: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
Tre Johnson - Out: Johnson has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers due to right Achilles soreness.
Justin Champagnie - Out: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
Tristan Vukcevic - Out: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Jamir Watkins - Out: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
Jonathan Huberdeau - Injured Reserve: Huberdeau (hip) skated with his teammates Saturday, but he isn't close to returning, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.
Samuel Honzek - Injured Reserve: ir
Zachary L'Heureux - Injured Reserve: ir-lt
Zach Hyman - Injured Reserve: ir
Devon Levi - Injured Reserve: Levi (undisclosed) is expected to miss a few weeks, per Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton.
Alec Regula - Injured Reserve: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.
Matt Savoie - Injured Reserve: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.
Frederik Andersen - Injured Reserve: Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.
Mattias Janmark - Injured Reserve: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.
Atro Leppanen - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Seamus Casey - Injured Reserve: Casey will be out of action for 6-8 weeks after undergoing a knee procedure, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports Friday.
Rasmus Ristolainen - Injured Reserve: Ristolainen (hand) was placed on injured reserve, retroactive to Oct. 24, on Tuesday.
Owen Tippett - Injured Reserve: Tippett (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per the NHL media site.
Travis Konecny - Injured Reserve: Konecny (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Sunday, according to the NHL media site.
Nikita Grebenkin - Injured Reserve: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.
Jared McCann - Injured Reserve: McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.

Jacob Melanson - Injured Reserve: Melanson's upper-body injury was diagnosed Saturday as an anterior mediastinum hematoma with vascular pseudo aneurysm. He will continue to be evaluated and is out indefinitely.
Ryan Lindgren - Injured Reserve: Lindgren (upper body) was placed on injured reserve by the Kraken on Thursday and is expected to miss four to six weeks.
Jake O'Brien - Injured Reserve: O'Brien (lower body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve Wednesday.
Miles Wood - Injured Reserve: Wood (undisclosed) was transferred to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.
Chris Tanev - Injured Reserve: The Maple Leafs announced Wednesday that Tanev (upper body) has been upgraded to day-to-day, Mark Masters of TSN reports.
Kirill Marchenko - Out: out
Nick Blankenburg - Injured Reserve: Blankenburg (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Maple Leafs on Friday, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.
Marshall Rifai - Injured Reserve: ir
John Tavares - Injured Reserve: ir
Max Domi - Injured Reserve: Domi (back) was transferred from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, per PuckPedia.
Cade Webber - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Elvis Merzlikins - Injured Reserve: Merzlikins is expected to miss 4-6 months to begin the 2026-27 regular season while recovering from a shoulder injury, per Luke Fox of Sportsnet.
William Villeneuve - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
Vincent Desharnais - Injured Reserve: ir
Rasmus Sandin - Injured Reserve: Sandin (knee) was placed on long-term injured reserve Monday.
Patrick Thomas - Injured Reserve: ir-nr
